packages.name: Adjust
packages.description: The manual colour panel every picture clip carries: exposure, tone, balance, sharpness and edge.

packages.name: After Hours
packages.description: Deep blacks, a cool cast over everything but the lamps, colour low, a little grain. Late-night desk and monologue footage.

packages.name: Aquamarine
packages.description: Water and sky turned aquamarine and brightened, sand and skin left warm and clean. The beach-day look creators reach for first.

packages.name: Autumn
packages.description: Greens pulled toward amber, the picture dipped in fall light.

packages.name: Bass
packages.description: More low end.

packages.name: Beat Shake
packages.description: A hit on every beat at the tempo you set, each knocked a different way, from the moment the clip or layer starts.

packages.name: Bleach Bypass
packages.description: The silver-retention film process: colour washed out, contrast pushed hard.

packages.name: Bloom Pulse
packages.description: A soft bloom over the highlights that breathes in and out.

packages.name: Blur Dissolve
packages.description: Both shots go soft towards the cut and the swap happens inside the blur, then the next one comes back into focus.

packages.name: Blush
packages.description: Skin warmed toward peach and softened, shadows lifted so lines ease, contrast low. Portraits and talking heads; it is meant to run at half strength.

packages.name: Bright
packages.description: Air and presence: a lift above six kilohertz.

packages.name: Bronze
packages.description: Sepia that keeps its contrast and its highlights, so it reads as old film rather than a brown wash.

packages.name: Cathedral
packages.description: Stone and height: reflections that take a while to arrive.

packages.name: Chipmunk
packages.description: Higher and squeakier.

packages.name: Chroma Key
packages.description: Keys out a green or blue screen - found by itself, or the colour picked off the picture - even where it is unevenly lit, cleaning its colour off the edges and the spill off the subject. For a black background, use Remove Black.

packages.name: Chromatic Aberration
packages.description: Red and blue pulled apart towards the edges, the colour fringing of a cheap lens.

packages.name: City Lights
packages.description: Night city: the lights and signs made vivid and blooming, blacks kept deep and cool, faces left clean. Made for the strip.

packages.name: Classic Chrome
packages.description: Muted highlights and deep, open shadows: the restrained look of a classic colour negative.

packages.name: Clean
packages.description: Barely there: neutral, a gentle curve, a touch more colour, and the reds calmed so a face reads even. What a talking head wants.

packages.name: Clock Wipe
packages.description: A hand sweeps once round the face of the frame from twelve, leaving the next shot behind it.

packages.name: Cloudless Sky
packages.description: Skies deeper and bluer, foliage cooler and calmer, the rest of the picture and every face untouched. Travel footage.

packages.name: Color Wheels
packages.description: Lift, gamma and gain: the shadows, midtones and highlights each pushed towards a hue and made brighter or darker.

packages.name: Contrast
packages.description: More or less contrast in stops about middle grey, highlights past white kept and black never crushed.

packages.name: Contrast Pop
packages.description: Deeper shadows, brighter highlights.

packages.name: Cool
packages.description: Shifts the picture towards daylight shade.

packages.name: Cool Blue
packages.description: Blue in the shadows and midtones, highlights and skin left neutral, contrast up. Cities at dusk.

packages.name: Corona
packages.description: A cool blue-white corona gathered off the picture's blown highlights by a golden-angle spiral blur - built from nothing, not a port of the stock halation.

packages.name: Cube
packages.description: The two shots are neighbouring faces of a box that turns a quarter of the way round, with the turning-away face falling into shade.

packages.name: Curves
packages.description: The picture's levels bent along curves you draw: luma for brightness alone, then red, green and blue.

packages.name: Cyberpunk
packages.description: Magenta into the shadows, cyan into the light, pushed hard and neon-bright.

packages.name: Deep
packages.description: Lower and fuller.

packages.name: Delicious
packages.description: Warm and saturated, the appetising push every food shot wants.

packages.name: Noise Reduction
packages.description: Takes the hum and hiss out from under the voice.

packages.name: Dissolve
packages.description: One shot melts evenly into the next.

packages.name: Distorted
packages.description: Driven hard and clipped.

packages.name: Dreamy
packages.description: A soft, hazy bloom over lifted pastel blacks.

packages.name: Echo
packages.description: One repeat, fading.

packages.name: Enhance Voice
packages.description: Clears the room out of a recording: rumble, hiss, sibilance and uneven level.

packages.name: Exposure
packages.description: Brighter or darker by stops of light, as the lens would make it, highlights kept.

packages.name: Fade to Black
packages.description: The outgoing shot fades down to black, then the incoming one fades up out of it.

packages.name: Fade to White
packages.description: The outgoing shot fades up to white, then the incoming one fades down out of it.

packages.name: Falling Dust
packages.description: A warm fade with dust drifting down through it and a light leak in one corner. The CPU shows the fade and a whisper of noise.

packages.name: Film
packages.description: A film curve with a real toe and shoulder, warm halation around the lights, and grain that moves. Print stock, not a filter.

packages.name: Film Burn
packages.description: A warm over-exposed flash burns through the cut.

packages.name: Film Grain
packages.description: Dancing grain, the texture of film stock.

packages.name: Fisheye
packages.description: The bulge of a very wide lens.

packages.name: Fresh
packages.description: Daylight footage made to pop: midtones lifted, colour brought up where it is muted, a breath of mint in the brightest whites, skin left alone.

packages.name: Gaussian Blur
packages.description: A soft, even blur.

packages.name: Glitch
packages.description: The picture breaks into torn bands that jump sideways and flicker between the two shots until the next one holds.

packages.name: Glitch Warp
packages.description: Chromatic slice tear and digital pixel displacement transition.

packages.name: Glow
packages.description: A soft bloom around the bright parts of the picture.

packages.name: Golden Hour
packages.description: Late light: a warm balance that keeps its brightness, orange in the highlights, a whisper of magenta in the shadows, blacks lifted a touch.

packages.name: Halation
packages.description: The red-orange halo film lays around its blown highlights, where light passes through the emulsion, scatters off the backing and comes back.

packages.name: Halftone
packages.description: The picture reduced to a grid of black and white dots.

packages.name: Hall
packages.description: A concert hall: long, even reflections.

packages.name: High-Contrast Mono
packages.description: Black and white pushed hard: deep blacks, bright whites, nothing in between.

packages.name: Impact
packages.description: One hard hit when the clip or layer starts: the frame jolts, punches in and rings out. Drop it on the beat.

packages.name: Indie
packages.description: Muted and green-teal through the midtones, a gentle film curve, warmth only where a face is. The quiet grade of an indie film.

packages.name: Instant Print
packages.description: The instant print: a cream matte, warm highlights, cyan creeping into the shadows, a little softness in the corners.

packages.name: Iris
packages.description: A round opening grows from the centre until the next shot fills the frame.

packages.name: Vivid Landscape
packages.description: Greens and blues pushed richer, the punch a travel shot wants.

packages.name: Light Leak Flash
packages.description: Organic overexposed film burn flash bridging the cut.

packages.name: Light Leak
packages.description: A wash of warm light flares across the frame and the next shot is left behind it as it passes.

packages.name: Linear Wipe
packages.description: A straight line crosses the frame and leaves the next shot behind it.

packages.name: Linen
packages.description: Whitewash's warm twin: the same soft matte with cream in the whites and a little gold in the middle. Interiors and morning light.

packages.name: Lo-fi
packages.description: A small old speaker: no top end, and a grain to the sound.

packages.name: Normalize Loudness
packages.description: Brings the whole clip to one loudness, the way broadcast and the platforms expect.

packages.name: Luma Key
packages.description: Keys out the dark of the picture - fire, smoke or sparks shot on black - or, inverted, the light.

packages.name: Luminous
packages.description: Faces brightened and evened: skin lifted, reds calmed, the balance neutral, the rest of the frame left where it was.

packages.name: Megaphone
packages.description: Harsh, mid-focused projection from a handheld megaphone.

packages.name: Mint Haze
packages.description: Soft green through the midtones and whites, colour muted, a light matte. The trend look, gentle enough for a face.

packages.name: Mono
packages.description: Black and white through a coloured filter: red darkens skies and lightens skin, green does the reverse. A little grain if you want it.

packages.name: Moody
packages.description: Blacks crushed by a film toe, colour drained, bronze through the middle, cool in the shadows, the corners closing in.

packages.name: Motion Blur
packages.description: A streak along a line, as if the camera panned.

packages.name: Natural
packages.description: A gentle, true-to-life lift: barely-there warmth, skin left alone.

packages.name: Neon
packages.description: Magenta in the shadows, cyan in the highlights, hard contrast, colour turned up, and the lights themselves blooming. Night streets and signage.

packages.name: Night
packages.description: Low light opened up: shadows lifted with the noise softened before it rises, whites held, the blue of the night kept.

packages.name: Noir
packages.description: Desaturated and heavy, with a cold cast into the shadows and the corners dimmed.

packages.name: Pink Fuzz
packages.description: Low contrast, pink and lavender in the light, and a soft bloom over it all. The dreamy one.

packages.name: Pitch
packages.description: Up or down by semitones, the length untouched.

packages.name: Pixelate
packages.description: Big square pixels.

packages.name: Plate
packages.description: A studio plate: dense, bright and short.

packages.name: Point and Shoot
packages.description: The 2000s point-and-shoot: hard flash, whites blown, colour up, a cool cyan cast, over-sharpened with the sensor's noise.

packages.name: Posterize
packages.description: Flat bands of colour, like a screen print.

packages.name: Prism Shake
packages.description: Red, green and blue each shake on their own, so every edge fringes with colour as the frame trembles.

packages.name: Push
packages.description: The next shot shoves the last one out of frame, both moving as one, with a streak of motion blur at full speed.

packages.name: Radio
packages.description: A small speaker on a long wave: narrow band, a little crunch.

packages.name: Remove Black
packages.description: Takes out a black background - fire, sparks, smoke, light leaks or a logo shot on black - keeping its glow as see-through light, with no dark fringe, over whatever is beneath and in an export with transparency.

packages.name: Retro 70s
packages.description: A heavy warm fade with a yellowed, sun-bleached cast.

packages.name: Retro Cartoon
packages.description: Flat bands of colour with inked edges, like a printed comic.

packages.name: RGB Split
packages.description: Red, green and blue tear apart through the cut, each switching shots at its own moment, and lock back together.

packages.name: Robot
packages.description: A metallic, modulated voice.

packages.name: Room
packages.description: The early reflections of a room.

packages.name: Rosy
packages.description: A soft pink lift into the highlights, flattering and warm.

packages.name: Saturation
packages.description: Richer or greyer colour, about each pixel's own brightness.

packages.name: Sci-Fi
packages.description: A cool, sterile steel-and-teal grade, saturation held back.

packages.name: Shake
packages.description: A camera that will not keep still: a handheld drift, a nervous jitter or a quake, with a turn and a smear of its own.

packages.name: Shape Wipe
packages.description: The next shot shows through a circle, heart or star that grows from the centre until it covers the frame.

packages.name: Sharpen
packages.description: Crisper edges.

packages.name: Silver
packages.description: A cool, soft black and white with the shadows lifted, like a silver print.

packages.name: Slide
packages.description: The next shot glides in over the last one and settles, casting a soft shadow on the shot it covers.

packages.name: Soft Light
packages.description: A matte: blacks lifted, whites eased down, contrast low, and a soft bloom in the light with cream in it. Airy and flattering.

packages.name: Spin
packages.description: The frame whirls round, blurring as it turns, and the next shot spins out of the turn and comes to rest.

packages.name: Spooky
packages.description: Drained colour, a green-cyan cast, a hard toe, and a heavy vignette. For the season.

packages.name: Stadium
packages.description: Vast stadium echoes and reverberations across a massive arena.

packages.name: Super 8
packages.description: Faded, warm and grainy: an old home movie run through a projector.

packages.name: Sweet
packages.description: A brighter, lighter, closer voice. Pitch at 0 follows the amount.

packages.name: Swirl
packages.description: Both shots twist round the centre like water down a drain, and the next one untwists out of the whirl.

packages.name: Teal & Orange
packages.description: Teal in the shadows, orange in the highlights, skin held as skin, a film curve over it. The blockbuster grade, and the most requested look there is.

packages.name: Telephone
packages.description: The narrow band of a phone line.

packages.name: Treble
packages.description: More sparkle.

packages.name: Tropical
packages.description: Saturated and bright, the water pushed teal.

packages.name: Underwater
packages.description: Submerged beneath the surface with heavy low-pass filtering.

packages.name: Vaporwave
packages.description: Magenta and cyan pushed hard, a saturated retro-synth cast.

packages.name: VHS
packages.description: Colour bleeding sideways, scan lines, softness, tape noise and too much saturation, with the slight vertical smear of a worn head.

packages.name: Vibrance
packages.description: Richer colour where it is muted, without blowing out what is already strong.

packages.name: Vignette
packages.description: Darkened corners that draw the eye to the middle.

packages.name: Vintage
packages.description: A seventies print: matte blacks and whites, colour faded, greens gone to yellow, a soft vignette.

packages.name: Vinyl
packages.description: Warm, vintage turntable character with band-limited sound.

packages.name: Vivid
packages.description: Colour that sings and contrast that bites, with a little edge: the look that reads as a better camera. Skin is held back from the boost.

packages.name: Walnut
packages.description: The café look: warm brown through the middle, greens muted to olive, contrast eased. Cosy, and kind to wood and skin alike.

packages.name: Warm
packages.description: Shifts the picture towards candlelight.

packages.name: Wet Street
packages.description: Cool, hazy and drained, with the wet reflections lifted and blooming. Street-level walks at the end of the day.

packages.name: Whip Pan
packages.description: The camera whips sideways so fast the frame smears, and lands on the next shot.

packages.name: Whisper
packages.description: Airy, breathy tone with attenuated low end and enhanced presence.

packages.name: White Balance
packages.description: The picture as if lit warmer or cooler, and turned towards magenta or green, as the eye adapts to the light.

packages.name: Whitewash
packages.description: Bright and matte: whites soft and cool, blacks lifted well off the floor, colour quiet. The clean minimal look of a white room.

packages.name: Window Seat
packages.description: Soft cinema: blacks lifted, the light blooming warm, shadows a touch cool, skin kept. The look of a story told in a window seat.

packages.name: Winter Cool
packages.description: Desaturated and blue, the blacks lifted to a matte wintry haze.

packages.name: Zoom Blur
packages.description: A rush towards a point, as if the lens zoomed during the shot.

packages.name: Zoom Blur
packages.description: The camera lunges into the last shot in a rush of streaks, and the next one rushes back out to meet it.

packages.name: Zoom
packages.description: One unbroken push of the camera: into the last shot and on out of it into the next, streaked by the speed.
